decisive_items: a 1.8 × 1.3 cm well-circumscribed, firm, non-tender, indurated lesion
an enlarged ipsilateral axillary lymph node presumed to represent metastatic disease
the lesion reappeared at the distal aspect of the thumb stump
response.rationale: Firm, non-tender, well-circumscribed recurrent skin lesion with regional nodal metastasis is classic for Merkel cell carcinoma; SCC is a common alternative but typically more hyperkeratotic/ulcerated, and melanoma lacks pigmented/irregular features.

rejected.why: SCC is a common differential but the lesion's well-circumscribed, non-tender, indurated quality and early nodal metastasis favor Merkel; no hyperkeratosis or ulceration is described.
Melanoma would more likely show pigmentation, irregular borders, or ulceration; not supported by the lesion description.
Misspelled variant of Merkel; not a valid diagnosis and duplicate of R1.
